title: Build a multi-vendor multisig
summary: A live 2-of-3 multisig with Trezor, Ledger and Coldcard in Sparrow, a restore in Nunchuk, and every link shared on the call.
share_text: Build a 2-of-3 multi-vendor multisig: notes + every resource from the @CodeOrangeDevs Self-Custody Workshop
tldr: Multisig from different vendors means one bad device can't take your coins.
2-of-3: any two keys can spend, so you can lose one and still be fine.
Back up the wallet file (output descriptor) everywhere. Without it you can't rebuild the wallet.
New to self-custody? Start with one hardware wallet, then a passphrase, then multisig.
